summary:
Bundle bndl-09d0d60e11897238 (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:13-15:13 UTC). The tip asked about records access and transfers this shift. The evidence does not support an incident in this window.

Transfers: One bulk outbound flow (~17.5 MB, records to 10.20.0.45 stor-nas-01, an approved backup destination) is policy-consistent (ev_af3d54bea7b4). Three kcole curl uploads of lab request PDFs went to 10.20.8.20 (lab-gw-01, approved), each well under the 5 MB threshold. No policy-violating bulk transfer was found.

Log integrity: The local-vs-collector check found no unexplained local absence. Missing workstation auth.log lines (16) and records access.log lines (199) all predate the oldest retained generation after scheduled rotation. The workstation forced logrotate by adm-tkim at 12:13:58 is recorded as an open note only.

Attribution: The kcole account was used for a console session at 12:05:36 while the badge for that account was inside the building. This is compatible with the holder or with anyone holding the credential. Account used; human operator not established. No person is named as responsible or cleared.

Not assessed: Staged files in /var/tmp/xfer (imm-registry-100/101/102.db, Aug-Oct 2026) and census CSVs have metadata dated outside this shift and are not linked to any in-window transfer. Printing census-1109.csv via lpr (kcole, 07:01 and 07:10) is not a transfer and was not assessed further.
